meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. The gradebook says zero, and nobody called me before it went in. Who decided that?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. Turnitin's own guide says that score shouldn't be the sole basis for adverse action against a student, and I have it printed in my bag. What else do you have?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My son doesn't lie, and I won't sit here while you accuse him with a number. I'm writing down that you said "your son cheated" and that a score from software is all you've offered so far. Where is the document?
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening his record to make me stop objecting, and I'm writing that down. Your own procedure, 4.5, puts a note on file only for repeated concerns, and nobody has told me there was a first. Nothing goes on his record, and I'm taking this to the principal today unless you show me something I can check.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology for how Owen found out, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written assurance that nothing goes on his record, with the principal next; that is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: Nothing, because you offered no document she could check beyond the software score.
What cost ground: You told her that her son cheated with only a detector score behind it, which let her fall back on her son never lying and on the company's own warning.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM, saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, watched Owen close it, and never asked; your evidence never got near that night because you gave no times or dates, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided on the zero, answer in one sentence that it went in before you called her, which procedure 4.2 says it should not have, and then put a dated document in front of her.
